scope: Rebuilt a separate copy of the existing Benzocaine report on the existing PC. No chemistry inference or Solar request was made. The released Benzocaine PDF/DOCX were not written.

verification.citation_map_used: report-specific citation-source-map.json; [17] maps to course material

public_release_copy_verification.citation_mapping: [17] points to the public course-material acquisition note; [18] and [19] retain their literature/patent assignments.
public_release_copy_verification.method: Read-only validation of copied release files using the package report, report-evidence bundle, citation audit, and report-specific citation map.

preserved_initial_validator_failure.recorded_error: Citation audit: Bibliography entry [17] points to a different source
preserved_initial_validator_failure.confirmed_cause: That first check implicitly used the package-wide citation map, which maps [17] to the rxn_yields notebook. The report revision has its own validated citation map, which maps [17] to the course material. The document validator was updated to prefer a report-specific citation map; the same generated DOCX/PDF then passed without changing report text or citation numbering.

source_map_pairing_diagnostic.detail: Applying the public derivative's citation map to the pre-anonymization local report fails because the local bibliography points to the original course PDF while the public derivative points to the acquisition note. Each report passes with its matching map; this pairing failure was preserved and not treated as a report-content correction.

limits: This is a saved-report document rebuild, not a fresh Benzocaine model run or Solar authoring call.
It confirms this report and current PC environment only; it does not prove clean-PC or all-target reproducibility.
